fields.description: Liabilities Fair Value, Recurring, Level 2

fields.name: fn_liab_fair_val_l2_q
fields.description: Liabilities Fair Value, Recurring, Level 2

fields.name: fn_liab_fair_val_l3_a
fields.description: Liabilities Fair Value, Recurring, Level 3

fields.name: fn_liab_fair_val_l3_q
fields.description: Liabilities Fair Value, Recurring, Level 3

fields.name: fn_liab_fair_val_q
fields.description: Liabilities Fair Value, Recurring, Total

fields.name: fn_line_of_credit_facility_amount_out_a
fields.description: Amount borrowed under the credit facility as of the balance sheet date.

fields.name: fn_line_of_credit_facility_amount_out_q
fields.description: Amount borrowed under the credit facility as of the balance sheet date.

fields.name: fn_line_of_credit_facility_max_borrowing_capacity_a
fields.description: Maximum borrowing capacity under the credit facility without consideration of any current restrictions on the amount that could be borrowed or the amounts currently outstanding under the facility.

fields.name: fn_line_of_credit_facility_max_borrowing_capacity_q
fields.description: Maximum borrowing capacity under the credit facility without consideration of any current restrictions on the amount that could be borrowed or the amounts currently outstanding under the facility.

fields.name: fn_mne_a
fields.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of tangible personal property used to produce goods and services, including, but is not limited to, tools, dies and molds, computer and office equipment.

fields.name: fn_new_shares_issued_a
fields.description: Number of new stock issued during the period.

fields.name: fn_new_shares_options_a
fields.description: Number of share options (or share units) exercised during the current period.

fields.name: fn_new_shares_options_q
fields.description: Number of share options (or share units) exercised during the current period.

fields.name: fn_op_lease_min_pay_due_a
fields.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable letter-terms in excess of 1 year.

fields.name: fn_op_lease_min_pay_due_after_5y_a
fields.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due after the 5th fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

fields.name: fn_op_lease_min_pay_due_in_2y_a
fields.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of 1 year due in the 2nd fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

fields.name: fn_op_lease_min_pay_due_in_3y_a
fields.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the 3rd fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

fields.name: fn_op_lease_min_pay_due_in_4y_a
fields.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of 1 year due in the 4th fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

fields.name: fn_op_lease_min_pay_due_in_5y_a
fields.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of 1 year due in the 5th fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

fields.name: fn_op_lease_rent_exp_a
fields.description: Rental expense for the reporting period incurred under operating leases, including minimum and any contingent rent expense, net of related sublease income.

fields.name: fn_oth_comp_fair_value_a
fields.description: Annual share-based compensation equity instruments other than options grants in period weighted average grant date fair value

fields.name: fn_oth_comp_forfeitures_fair_value_a
fields.description: Annual Share Based Compensation Equity Instruments Other Than Options Forfeitures Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value

fields.name: fn_oth_comp_grants_weighted_avg_grant_date_fair_value_a
fields.description: Annual Share-Based Compensation Equity Instruments Other Than Options Nonvested Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value

fields.name: fn_oth_comp_grants_weighted_avg_grant_date_fair_value_q
fields.description: Quarterly Share-Based Compensation Equity Instruments Other Than Options Nonvested Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_available_for_sale_securities_adj_of_tax_a
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of appreciation (loss) in value of unsold available-for-sale securities. Excludes amounts related to other than temporary impairment (OTTI) loss.

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_available_for_sale_securities_adj_of_tax_q
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of appreciation (loss) in value of unsold available-for-sale securities. Excludes amounts related to other than temporary impairment (OTTI) loss.

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_derivatives_qualifying_as_hedges_of_tax_a
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_derivatives_qualifying_as_hedges_of_tax_q
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_fx_transaction_and_tax_translation_adj_a
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity, and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_fx_transaction_and_tax_translation_adj_q
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_net_of_tax_a
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_net_of_tax_q
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

fields.name: fn_payments_for_repurchase_of_common_stock_a
fields.description: Value reported on Cash Flow Statement. May include shares repurchased as part of a buyback plan, as well as shares purchased for employee compensation, etc.

fields.name: fn_payments_for_repurchase_of_common_stock_q
fields.description: Value reported on Cash Flow Statement. May include shares repurchased as part of a buyback plan, as well as shares purchased for employee compensation, etc.

fields.name: fn_payments_to_acquire_businesses_net_of_cash_acquired_a
fields.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

fields.name: fn_payments_to_acquire_businesses_net_of_cash_acquired_q
fields.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

fields.name: fn_ppne_gross_a
fields.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

fields.name: fn_ppne_gross_q
fields.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

fields.name: fn_prepaid_expense_a
fields.description: Carrying amount for an unclassified balance sheet date of expenditures made in advance of when the economic benefit of the cost will be realized, and which will be expensed in future periods with the passage of time or when a triggering event occurs. For a classified balance sheet, represents the noncurrent portion of prepaid expenses (the current portion has a separate concept).

fields.name: fn_prepaid_expense_q
fields.description: Carrying amount for an unclassified balance sheet date of expenditures made in advance of when the economic benefit of the cost will be realized, and which will be expensed in future periods with the passage of time or when a triggering event occurs. For a classified balance sheet, represents the noncurrent portion of prepaid expenses (the current portion has a separate concept).

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_issuance_of_common_stock_a
fields.description: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_issuance_of_common_stock_q
fields.description: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_issuance_of_debt_a
fields.description: The cash inflow during the period from additional borrowings in aggregate debt. Includes proceeds from short-term and long-term debt.

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_issuance_of_debt_q
fields.description: The cash inflow during the period from additional borrowings in aggregate debt. Includes proceeds from short-term and long-term debt.

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_lt_debt_a
fields.description: Proceeds From Issuance Of Debt, Long Term

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_lt_debt_q
fields.description: Proceeds From Issuance Of Debt, Long Term

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_stock_options_exercised_a
fields.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from holders exercising their stock options. This item inherently excludes any excess tax benefit, which the entity may have realized and reported separately.

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_stock_options_exercised_q
fields.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from holders exercising their stock options. This item inherently excludes any excess tax benefit, which the entity may have realized and reported separately.

fields.name: fn_profit_loss_a
fields.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

fields.name: fn_profit_loss_q
fields.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

fields.name: fn_repayments_of_debt_a
fields.description: The cash outflow during the period from the repayment of aggregate short-term and long-term debt. Excludes payment of capital lease obligations.

fields.name: fn_repayments_of_debt_q
fields.description: The cash outflow during the period from the repayment of aggregate short-term and long-term debt. Excludes payment of capital lease obligations.

fields.name: fn_repayments_of_lines_of_credit_a
fields.description: Amount of cash outflow for payment of an obligation from a lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.

fields.name: fn_repayments_of_lines_of_credit_q
fields.description: Amount of cash outflow for payment of an obligation from a lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.

fields.name: fn_repayments_of_lt_debt_a
fields.description: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after 1 year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

fields.name: fn_repayments_of_lt_debt_q
fields.description: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after 1 year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

fields.name: fn_repurchased_shares_a
fields.description: Number of shares that have been repurchased during the period.

fields.name: fn_repurchased_shares_q
fields.description: Number of shares that have been repurchased during the period.

fields.name: fn_repurchased_shares_value_a
fields.description: Shares repurchased and either retired or put into treasury stock, likely as part of a share buyback plan.

fields.name: fn_repurchased_shares_value_q
fields.description: Shares repurchased and either retired or put into treasury stock, likely as part of a share buyback plan.

fields.name: fn_taxes_payable_a
fields.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory income, sales, use, payroll, excise, real, property, and other taxes. For classified balance sheets, used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within 1 year or within the normal operating cycle if longer); for unclassified balance sheets, used to reflect the total liabilities (regardless of due date).

fields.name: fn_taxes_payable_q
fields.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory income, sales, use, payroll, excise, real, property and other taxes. For classified balance sheets, used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within 1 year or within the normal operating cycle if longer); for unclassified balance sheets, used to reflect the total liabilities (regardless of due date).

fields.name: fn_treasury_stock_shares_a
fields.description: Number of common and preferred shares that were previously issued and that were repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury on the financial statement date. This stock has no voting rights and receives no dividends.

fields.name: fn_treasury_stock_shares_q
fields.description: Number of common and preferred shares that were previously issued and that were repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury on the financial statement date. This stock has no voting rights and receives no dividends.

fields.name: fn_unrecognized_tax_benefits_a
fields.description: Amount of unrecognized tax benefits.

fields.name: fnd2_a_acmopclcchngcfectnt
fields.description: Accumulated change, net of tax, in accumulated gains and losses from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges. Includes an entity's share of an equity investee's Increase or Decrease in deferred hedging gains or losses.

fields.name: fnd2_a_acmopcldbpoprpnt
fields.description: The total of net gain (loss), prior service cost (credit), and transition assets (obligations), as well as minimum pension liability if still remaining, included in accumulated other comprehensive income associated with a defined benefit pension or other postretirement plan(s) because they have yet to be recognized as components of net periodic benefit cost.

fields.name: fnd2_a_allfdbflaccrwriteoffs
fields.description: Amount of recoveries of receivables doubtful of collection that were previously charged off.

fields.name: fnd2_a_alsbcmpexrsus
fields.description: Allocated Share-Based Compensation Expense, Restricted Stock Units

fields.name: fnd2_a_atdlsecexfcepsastkos
fields.description: Antidilutive Shares Excluded From Earnings Per Share Amount, Stock Options

fields.name: fnd2_a_blgandiprtsg
fields.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of building structures held for productive use including addition, improvement, or renovation to the structure, including, but not limited to, interior masonry, interior flooring, electrical, and plumbing.

fields.name: fnd2_a_bnsacqproformarvn
fields.description: The pro forma revenue for a period as if the business combination or combinations had been completed at the beginning of the period.

fields.name: fnd2_a_bnscbmacqrcsts
fields.description: This element represents acquisition-related costs incurred to effect a business combination which costs have been expensed during the period. Such costs include finder's fees; advisory, legal, accounting, valuation, and other professional or consulting fees; general administrative costs, including the costs of maintaining an internal acquisitions department; and may include costs of registering and issuing debt and equity securities.

fields.name: fnd2_a_consinprogressg
fields.description: Amount of structure or a modification to a structure under construction. Includes recently completed structures or modifications to structures that have not been placed into service.

fields.name: fnd2_a_curritxexp
fields.description: Income Tax Expense, Current

fields.name: fnd2_a_dbplanepdrtnplas
fields.description: An amount calculated as a basis for determining the extent of delayed recognition of the effects of changes in the fair value of assets. The expected return on plan assets is determined based on the expected long-term rate of return on plan assets and the market-related value of plan assets.

fields.name: fnd2_a_dbplanintcst
fields.description: The increase in a defined benefit pension plan's projected benefit obligation or a defined benefit postretirement plan's accumulated postretirement benefit obligation due to the passage of time.

fields.name: fnd2_a_dbplannpicbnfcst
fields.description: The total amount of net periodic benefit cost for defined benefit plans for the period. Periodic benefit costs include the following components: service cost, interest cost, expected return on plan assets, gain (loss), prior service cost or credit, transition asset or obligation, and gain (loss) due to settlements or curtailments.

fields.name: fnd2_a_dbplanservicecst
fields.description: The actuarial present value of benefits attributed by the pension benefit formula to services rendered by employees during the period. The portion of the expected postretirement benefit obligation attributed to employee service during the period. The service cost component is a portion of the benefit obligation and is unaffected by the funded status of the plan.

fields.name: fnd2_a_dbplctrbyemp
fields.description: Amount of contributions made by the employer to defined benefit plans.

fields.name: fnd2_a_dfdtxava
fields.description: Amount of deferred tax assets for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

fields.name: fnd2_a_eplsbvdcpcstnrgprg
fields.description: The weighted average period over which unrecognized compensation is expected to be recognized for equity-based compensation plans, using a decimal to express in number of years.

fields.name: fnd2_a_eplsbvdcpcstnrgsbaoo
fields.description: Unrecognized cost of unvested other share-based compensation awards.

fields.name: fnd2_a_eplsrbcpntxbnffcmpex
fields.description: The total recognized tax benefit related to compensation cost for equity-based payment arrangements recognized in income during the period.

fields.name: fnd2_a_excesstxbnffsbcpnoprat
fields.description: Amount of cash outflow for realized tax benefit related to deductible compensation cost reported on the entity's tax return for equity instruments in excess of the compensation cost for those instruments recognized for financial reporting purposes.

datasets.name: Report Footnotes
datasets.description: This dataset provides granular financial statement footnote data for publicly traded companies, extracted using advanced XBRL technology. It includes detailed disclosures on items such as goodwill, deferred taxes, share-based compensation, and other key financial metrics not typically found in headline financial tables. By enabling users to drill down into historical and cross-company footnote information, the dataset offers unique insights into accounting policies, risk exposures, and non-standard financial events. Such depth of information can help analysts identify hidden risks, spot trends in corporate behavior, and improve the accuracy of fundamental models for predicting price movements.

fields.name: fn_comp_options_forfeitures_and_expirations_q

fields.name: fn_comp_options_out_weighted_avg_q

fields.name: fn_derivative_fair_value_of_derivative_asset_a
fields.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

fields.name: fn_derivative_fair_value_of_derivative_asset_q
fields.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

fields.name: fn_derivative_fair_value_of_derivative_liability_a
fields.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

fields.name: fn_derivative_fair_value_of_derivative_liability_q
fields.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

fields.name: fn_derivative_notional_amount_q

fields.name: fn_effect_of_exchange_rate_on_cash_and_equiv_q

fields.name: fn_employee_related_liab_a
fields.description: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits. For classified balance sheets, used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within 1 year or within the normal operating cycle if longer); for unclassified balance sheets, used to reflect the total liabilities (regardless of due date).

fields.name: fn_employee_related_liab_q
fields.description: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits. For classified balance sheets, used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within 1 year or within the normal operating cycle if longer); for unclassified balance sheets, used to reflect the total liabilities (regardless of due date).

fields.name: fn_entity_common_stock_shares_out_a
fields.description: Indicate number of shares or other units outstanding of each of registrant's classes of capital or common stock or other ownership interests, if and as stated on cover of related periodic report. Where multiple classes or units exist define each class/interest by adding class of stock items such as Common Class A [Member], Common Class B [Member] or Partnership Interest [Member] onto the Instrument [Domain] of the Entity Listings, Instrument.

fields.name: fn_entity_common_stock_shares_out_q
fields.description: Indicate number of shares or other units outstanding of each of registrant's classes of capital or common stock or other ownership interests, if and as stated on cover of related periodic report. Where multiple classes or units exist define each class/interest by adding class of stock items such as Common Class A [Member], Common Class B [Member] or Partnership Interest [Member] onto the Instrument [Domain] of the Entity Listings, Instrument.

fields.name: fn_excess_tax_benefit_from_share_based_comp_fin_activities_a

fields.name: fn_excess_tax_benefit_from_share_based_comp_fin_activities_q

fields.name: fn_intangible_assets_accum_amort_q

fields.name: fn_op_lease_min_pay_due_in_4y_a

fields.name: fn_op_lease_min_pay_due_in_5y_a

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_fx_transaction_and_tax_translation_adj_q

fields.name: fn_prepaid_expense_q

For a classified balance sheet, represents the noncurrent portion of prepaid expenses (the current portion has a separate concept).

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_issuance_of_common_stock_q

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_issuance_of_debt_q

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_stock_options_exercised_q

fields.name: fn_taxes_payable_q

datasets.name: Report Footnotes
datasets.description: This dataset provides granular financial statement footnote data for publicly traded companies, extracted using advanced XBRL technology. It includes detailed disclosures on items such as goodwill, deferred taxes, share-based compensation, and other key financial metrics not typically found in headline financial tables. By enabling users to drill down into historical and cross-company footnote information, the dataset offers unique insights into accounting policies, risk exposures, and non-standard financial events. Such depth of information can help analysts identify hidden risks, spot trends in corporate behavior, and improve the accuracy of fundamental models for predicting price movements.

fields.name: fn_accum_oth_income_loss_net_of_tax_a
fields.description: Accumulated change in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources, net of tax effect, at period end. Excludes Net Income (Loss), and accumulated changes in equity from transactions resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners. Includes foreign currency translation items, certain pension adjustments, unrealized gains and losses on certain investments in debt and equity securities, other than temporary impairment (OTTI) losses related to factors other than credit losses on available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities that an entity does not intend to sell and it is not more likely than not that the entity will be required to sell before recovery of the amortized cost basis, as well as changes in the fair value of derivatives related to the effective portion of a designated cash flow hedge.

fields.name: fn_accum_oth_income_loss_net_of_tax_q
fields.description: Accumulated change in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources, net of tax effect, at period end. Excludes Net Income (Loss), and accumulated changes in equity from transactions resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners. Includes foreign currency translation items, certain pension adjustments, unrealized gains and losses on certain investments in debt and equity securities, other than temporary impairment (OTTI) losses related to factors other than credit losses on available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities that an entity does not intend to sell and it is not more likely than not that the entity will be required to sell before recovery of the amortized cost basis, as well as changes in the fair value of derivatives related to the effective portion of a designated cash flow hedge.

datasets.name: Report Footnotes
datasets.description: This dataset provides granular financial statement footnote data for publicly traded companies, extracted using advanced XBRL technology. It includes detailed disclosures on items such as goodwill, deferred taxes, share-based compensation, and other key financial metrics not typically found in headline financial tables. By enabling users to drill down into historical and cross-company footnote information, the dataset offers unique insights into accounting policies, risk exposures, and non-standard financial events. Such depth of information can help analysts identify hidden risks, spot trends in corporate behavior, and improve the accuracy of fundamental models for predicting price movements.

fields.name: fn_prepaid_expense_q

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_stock_options_exercised_q

fields.name: fn_taxes_payable_q

datasets.name: Report Footnotes
datasets.description: This dataset provides granular financial statement footnote data for publicly traded companies, extracted using advanced XBRL technology. It includes detailed disclosures on items such as goodwill, deferred taxes, share-based compensation, and other key financial metrics not typically found in headline financial tables. By enabling users to drill down into historical and cross-company footnote information, the dataset offers unique insights into accounting policies, risk exposures, and non-standard financial events. Such depth of information can help analysts identify hidden risks, spot trends in corporate behavior, and improve the accuracy of fundamental models for predicting price movements.

datasets.name: Report Footnotes
datasets.description: This dataset provides granular financial statement footnote data for publicly traded companies, extracted using advanced XBRL technology. It includes detailed disclosures on items such as goodwill, deferred taxes, share-based compensation, and other key financial metrics not typically found in headline financial tables. By enabling users to drill down into historical and cross-company footnote information, the dataset offers unique insights into accounting policies, risk exposures, and non-standard financial events. Such depth of information can help analysts identify hidden risks, spot trends in corporate behavior, and improve the accuracy of fundamental models for predicting price movements.

fields.name: fn_employee_related_liab_q

fields.name: fn_entity_common_stock_shares_out_a

fields.name: fn_op_lease_min_pay_due_in_3y_a

fields.name: fn_op_lease_min_pay_due_in_4y_a

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_derivatives_qualifying_as_hedges_of_tax_q

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_fx_transaction_and_tax_translation_adj_a
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity, and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_fx_transaction_and_tax_translation_adj_q

fields.name: fn_payments_for_repurchase_of_common_stock_a

fields.name: fn_payments_for_repurchase_of_common_stock_q

fields.name: fn_ppne_gross_q

fields.name: fn_prepaid_expense_a

For a classified balance sheet, represents the noncurrent portion of prepaid expenses (the current portion has a separate concept).

fields.name: fn_prepaid_expense_q
fields.description: Carrying amount for an unclassified balance sheet date of expenditures made in advance of when the economic benefit of the cost will be realized, and which will be expensed in future periods with the passage of time or when a triggering event occurs. For a classified balance sheet, represents the noncurrent portion of prepaid expenses (the current portion has a separate concept).

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_issuance_of_common_stock_q

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_issuance_of_debt_q

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_stock_options_exercised_q

fields.name: fn_profit_loss_q

fields.name: fn_repayments_of_debt_q

fields.name: fn_repayments_of_lines_of_credit_q

fields.name: fn_repurchased_shares_value_q

For classified balance sheets, used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within 1 year or within the normal operating cycle if longer); for unclassified balance sheets, used to reflect the total liabilities (regardless of due date).

fields.name: fn_taxes_payable_q

fields.name: fn_treasury_stock_shares_a

fields.name: fnd2_a_inventoryfinishedgoods

fields.name: fnd2_a_inventoryrawmaterials

datasets.name: Report Footnotes
datasets.description: This dataset provides granular financial statement footnote data for publicly traded companies, extracted using advanced XBRL technology. It includes detailed disclosures on items such as goodwill, deferred taxes, share-based compensation, and other key financial metrics not typically found in headline financial tables. By enabling users to drill down into historical and cross-company footnote information, the dataset offers unique insights into accounting policies, risk exposures, and non-standard financial events. Such depth of information can help analysts identify hidden risks, spot trends in corporate behavior, and improve the accuracy of fundamental models for predicting price movements.

fields.description: Accumulated change in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources, net of tax effect, at period end. Excludes Net Income (Loss), and accumulated changes in equity from transactions resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners. Includes foreign currency translation items, certain pension adjustments, unrealized gains and losses on certain investments in debt and equity securities, other than temporary impairment (OTTI) losses related to factors other than credit losses on available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities that an entity does not intend to sell and it is not more likely than not that the entity will be required to sell before recovery of the amortized cost basis, as well as changes in the fair value of derivatives related to the effective portion of a designated cash flow hedge.

fields.name: fn_accum_oth_income_loss_net_of_tax_q

Excludes Net Income (Loss), and accumulated changes in equity from transactions resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners. Includes foreign currency translation items, certain pension adjustments, unrealized gains and losses on certain investments in debt and equity securities, other than temporary impairment (OTTI) losses related to factors other than credit losses on available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities that an entity does not intend to sell and it is not more likely than not that the entity will be required to sell before recovery of the amortized cost basis, as well as changes in the fair value of derivatives related to the effective portion of a designated cash flow hedge.

fields.name: fn_comp_options_out_intrinsic_value_q
fields.description: The intrinsic value of a stock option is the amount by which the market value of the underlying stock exceeds the exercise price of the option.

fields.name: fn_comp_options_out_number_a
fields.description: Number of options outstanding, including both vested and non-vested options.

fields.name: fn_comp_options_out_number_q
fields.description: Number of options outstanding, including both vested and non-vested options.

fields.name: fn_comp_options_out_weighted_avg_a
fields.description: Weighted average price at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance under the stock option plan.

fields.name: fn_comp_options_out_weighted_avg_q
fields.description: Weighted average price at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance under the stock option plan.

fields.name: fn_comprehensive_income_net_of_tax_a
fields.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income, attributable to parent entity. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

fields.name: fn_comprehensive_income_net_of_tax_q
fields.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income, attributable to parent entity. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

fields.name: fn_debt_instrument_carrying_amount_a
fields.description: Debt carrying amount

fields.name: fn_debt_instrument_carrying_amount_q
fields.description: Debt carrying amount

fields.name: fn_debt_instrument_face_amount_a
fields.description: Debt face amount

fields.name: fn_debt_instrument_face_amount_q
fields.description: Debt face amount

fields.name: fn_debt_instrument_interest_rate_stated_percentage_a
fields.description: Stated percentage of interest rate on debt

fields.name: fn_debt_instrument_interest_rate_stated_percentage_q
fields.description: Stated percentage of interest rate on debt

fields.name: fn_debt_issuance_costs_a
fields.description: Amount of debt issuance costs (for example, but not limited to, legal, accounting, broker, and regulatory fees).

fields.name: fn_debt_issuance_costs_q
fields.description: Amount of debt issuance costs (for example, but not limited to, legal, accounting, broker, and regulatory fees).

fields.name: fn_def_income_tax_expense_a
fields.description: Income Tax Expense, Deferred

fields.name: fn_def_income_tax_expense_q
fields.description: Income Tax Expense, Deferred

fields.name: fn_def_tax_assets_liab_net_a
fields.description: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, without jurisdictional netting.

fields.name: fn_def_tax_assets_liab_net_q
fields.description: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, without jurisdictional netting.

fields.name: fn_def_tax_assets_net_a
fields.description: Deferred Tax Assets Net Of Valuation Allowance

fields.name: fn_def_tax_assets_net_q
fields.description: Deferred Tax Assets Net Of Valuation Allowance

fields.name: fn_def_tax_liab_a
fields.description: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences without jurisdictional netting.

fields.name: fn_def_tax_liab_q
fields.description: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences without jurisdictional netting.

fields.name: fn_derivative_fair_value_of_derivative_asset_a
fields.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

fields.name: fn_derivative_fair_value_of_derivative_asset_q
fields.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

fields.name: fn_derivative_fair_value_of_derivative_liability_a
fields.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

fields.name: fn_derivative_fair_value_of_derivative_liability_q
fields.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

fields.name: fn_derivative_notional_amount_a
fields.description: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payments on the derivative liability.

fields.name: fn_derivative_notional_amount_q
fields.description: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payments on the derivative liability.

fields.name: fn_eff_income_tax_rate_continuing_operations_a
fields.description: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

fields.name: fn_eff_income_tax_rate_continuing_operations_q
fields.description: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

fields.name: fn_effect_of_exchange_rate_on_cash_and_equiv_a
fields.description: Amount of increase (decrease) from the effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalent balances held in foreign currencies.

fields.name: fn_effect_of_exchange_rate_on_cash_and_equiv_q
fields.description: Amount of increase (decrease) from the effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalent balances held in foreign currencies.

fields.name: fn_employee_related_liab_a
fields.description: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits. For classified balance sheets, used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within 1 year or within the normal operating cycle if longer); for unclassified balance sheets, used to reflect the total liabilities (regardless of due date).

fields.name: fn_employee_related_liab_q
fields.description: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits. For classified balance sheets, used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within 1 year or within the normal operating cycle if longer); for unclassified balance sheets, used to reflect the total liabilities (regardless of due date).

fields.name: fn_entity_common_stock_shares_out_a
fields.description: Indicate number of shares or other units outstanding of each of registrant's classes of capital or common stock or other ownership interests, if and as stated on cover of related periodic report. Where multiple classes or units exist define each class/interest by adding class of stock items such as Common Class A [Member], Common Class B [Member] or Partnership Interest [Member] onto the Instrument [Domain] of the Entity Listings, Instrument.

fields.name: fn_entity_common_stock_shares_out_q
fields.description: Indicate number of shares or other units outstanding of each of registrant's classes of capital or common stock or other ownership interests, if and as stated on cover of related periodic report. Where multiple classes or units exist define each class/interest by adding class of stock items such as Common Class A [Member], Common Class B [Member] or Partnership Interest [Member] onto the Instrument [Domain] of the Entity Listings, Instrument.

fields.name: fn_excess_tax_benefit_from_share_based_comp_fin_activities_a
fields.description: Amount of cash inflow from realized tax benefit related to deductible compensation cost reported on the entity's tax return for equity instruments in excess of the compensation cost for those instruments recognized for financial reporting purposes.

fields.name: fn_excess_tax_benefit_from_share_based_comp_fin_activities_q
fields.description: Amount of cash inflow from realized tax benefit related to deductible compensation cost reported on the entity's tax return for equity instruments in excess of the compensation cost for those instruments recognized for financial reporting purposes.

fields.name: fn_finite_lived_intangible_assets_acq_a
fields.description: Amount of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life acquired.

fields.name: fn_finite_lived_intangible_assets_acq_q
fields.description: Amount of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life acquired.

fields.name: fn_finite_lived_intangible_assets_gross_a
fields.description: Amount before amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

fields.name: fn_finite_lived_intangible_assets_gross_q
fields.description: Amount before amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

fields.name: fn_finite_lived_intangible_assets_net_a
fields.description: Finite Lived Intangible Assets, Net

fields.name: fn_finite_lived_intangible_assets_net_q
fields.description: Finite Lived Intangible Assets, Net

fields.name: fn_goodwill_acquired_during_period_a
fields.description: Amount of increase in asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized resulting from a business combination.

fields.name: fn_goodwill_acquired_during_period_q
fields.description: Amount of increase in asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized resulting from a business combination.

fields.name: fn_income_from_equity_investments_a
fields.description: Income From Equity Method Investments

fields.name: fn_income_from_equity_investments_q
fields.description: Income From Equity Method Investments

fields.name: fn_income_tax_expense_a
fields.description: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)

fields.name: fn_income_tax_expense_q
fields.description: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)

fields.name: fn_income_taxes_paid_a
fields.description: The amount of cash paid during the current period to foreign, federal, state, and local authorities as taxes on income.

fields.name: fn_income_taxes_paid_q
fields.description: The amount of cash paid during the current period to foreign, federal, state, and local authorities as taxes on income.

fields.name: fn_incremental_shares_attributable_to_share_based_payment_a
fields.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of share-based payment arrangements using the treasury stock method.

fields.name: fn_incremental_shares_attributable_to_share_based_payment_q
fields.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of share-based payment arrangements using the treasury stock method.

fields.name: fn_intangible_assets_accum_amort_a
fields.description: Accumulated amount of amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

fields.name: fn_intangible_assets_accum_amort_q
fields.description: Accumulated amount of amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

fields.name: fn_interest_paid_net_a
fields.description: Net interest

fields.name: fn_interest_paid_net_q
fields.description: Net interest

fields.name: fn_interest_payable_a
fields.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of [accrued] interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred and is unpaid. For classified balance sheets, used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within 1 year or within the normal operating cycle if longer); for unclassified balance sheets, used to reflect the total liabilities (regardless of due date).

fields.name: fn_interest_payable_q
fields.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of accrued interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred and is unpaid. For classified balance sheets, used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within 1 year or within the normal operating cycle if longer); for unclassified balance sheets, used to reflect the total liabilities (regardless of due date).

fields.name: fn_liab_fair_val_a
fields.description: Liabilities Fair Value, Recurring, Total

fields.name: fn_liab_fair_val_l1_a
fields.description: Liabilities Fair Value, Recurring, Level 1

fields.name: fn_liab_fair_val_l1_q
fields.description: Liabilities Fair Value, Recurring, Level 1

fields.name: fn_liab_fair_val_l2_a
fields.description: Liabilities Fair Value, Recurring, Level 2

fields.name: fn_liab_fair_val_l2_q
fields.description: Liabilities Fair Value, Recurring, Level 2

fields.name: fn_liab_fair_val_l3_a
fields.description: Liabilities Fair Value, Recurring, Level 3

fields.name: fn_liab_fair_val_l3_q
fields.description: Liabilities Fair Value, Recurring, Level 3

fields.name: fn_liab_fair_val_q
fields.description: Liabilities Fair Value, Recurring, Total

fields.name: fn_line_of_credit_facility_amount_out_a
fields.description: Amount borrowed under the credit facility as of the balance sheet date.

fields.name: fn_line_of_credit_facility_amount_out_q
fields.description: Amount borrowed under the credit facility as of the balance sheet date.

fields.name: fn_line_of_credit_facility_max_borrowing_capacity_a
fields.description: Maximum borrowing capacity under the credit facility without consideration of any current restrictions on the amount that could be borrowed or the amounts currently outstanding under the facility.

fields.name: fn_line_of_credit_facility_max_borrowing_capacity_q
fields.description: Maximum borrowing capacity under the credit facility without consideration of any current restrictions on the amount that could be borrowed or the amounts currently outstanding under the facility.

fields.name: fn_mne_a
fields.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of tangible personal property used to produce goods and services, including, but is not limited to, tools, dies and molds, computer and office equipment.

fields.name: fn_new_shares_issued_a
fields.description: Number of new stock issued during the period.

fields.name: fn_new_shares_options_a
fields.description: Number of share options (or share units) exercised during the current period.

fields.name: fn_new_shares_options_q
fields.description: Number of share options (or share units) exercised during the current period.

fields.name: fn_op_lease_min_pay_due_a
fields.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable letter-terms in excess of 1 year.

fields.name: fn_op_lease_min_pay_due_after_5y_a
fields.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due after the 5th fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

fields.name: fn_op_lease_min_pay_due_in_2y_a
fields.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of 1 year due in the 2nd fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

fields.name: fn_op_lease_min_pay_due_in_3y_a
fields.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the 3rd fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

fields.name: fn_op_lease_min_pay_due_in_4y_a
fields.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of 1 year due in the 4th fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

fields.name: fn_op_lease_min_pay_due_in_5y_a
fields.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of 1 year due in the 5th fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

fields.name: fn_op_lease_rent_exp_a
fields.description: Rental expense for the reporting period incurred under operating leases, including minimum and any contingent rent expense, net of related sublease income.

fields.name: fn_oth_comp_fair_value_a
fields.description: Annual share-based compensation equity instruments other than options grants in period weighted average grant date fair value

fields.name: fn_oth_comp_forfeitures_fair_value_a
fields.description: Annual Share Based Compensation Equity Instruments Other Than Options Forfeitures Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value

fields.name: fn_oth_comp_grants_weighted_avg_grant_date_fair_value_a
fields.description: Annual Share-Based Compensation Equity Instruments Other Than Options Nonvested Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value

fields.name: fn_oth_comp_grants_weighted_avg_grant_date_fair_value_q
fields.description: Quarterly Share-Based Compensation Equity Instruments Other Than Options Nonvested Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_available_for_sale_securities_adj_of_tax_a
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of appreciation (loss) in value of unsold available-for-sale securities. Excludes amounts related to other than temporary impairment (OTTI) loss.

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_available_for_sale_securities_adj_of_tax_q
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of appreciation (loss) in value of unsold available-for-sale securities. Excludes amounts related to other than temporary impairment (OTTI) loss.

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_derivatives_qualifying_as_hedges_of_tax_a
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_derivatives_qualifying_as_hedges_of_tax_q
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_fx_transaction_and_tax_translation_adj_a
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity, and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_fx_transaction_and_tax_translation_adj_q
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_net_of_tax_a
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_net_of_tax_q
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

fields.name: fn_payments_for_repurchase_of_common_stock_a
fields.description: Value reported on Cash Flow Statement. May include shares repurchased as part of a buyback plan, as well as shares purchased for employee compensation, etc.

fields.name: fn_payments_for_repurchase_of_common_stock_q
fields.description: Value reported on Cash Flow Statement. May include shares repurchased as part of a buyback plan, as well as shares purchased for employee compensation, etc.

fields.name: fn_payments_to_acquire_businesses_net_of_cash_acquired_a
fields.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

fields.name: fn_payments_to_acquire_businesses_net_of_cash_acquired_q
fields.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

fields.name: fn_ppne_gross_a
fields.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

fields.name: fn_ppne_gross_q
fields.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

fields.name: fn_prepaid_expense_a
fields.description: Carrying amount for an unclassified balance sheet date of expenditures made in advance of when the economic benefit of the cost will be realized, and which will be expensed in future periods with the passage of time or when a triggering event occurs. For a classified balance sheet, represents the noncurrent portion of prepaid expenses (the current portion has a separate concept).

fields.name: fn_prepaid_expense_q
fields.description: Carrying amount for an unclassified balance sheet date of expenditures made in advance of when the economic benefit of the cost will be realized, and which will be expensed in future periods with the passage of time or when a triggering event occurs. For a classified balance sheet, represents the noncurrent portion of prepaid expenses (the current portion has a separate concept).

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_issuance_of_common_stock_a
fields.description: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_issuance_of_common_stock_q
fields.description: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_issuance_of_debt_a
fields.description: The cash inflow during the period from additional borrowings in aggregate debt. Includes proceeds from short-term and long-term debt.

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_issuance_of_debt_q
fields.description: The cash inflow during the period from additional borrowings in aggregate debt. Includes proceeds from short-term and long-term debt.

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_lt_debt_a
fields.description: Proceeds From Issuance Of Debt, Long Term

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_lt_debt_q
fields.description: Proceeds From Issuance Of Debt, Long Term

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_stock_options_exercised_a
fields.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from holders exercising their stock options. This item inherently excludes any excess tax benefit, which the entity may have realized and reported separately.

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_stock_options_exercised_q
fields.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from holders exercising their stock options. This item inherently excludes any excess tax benefit, which the entity may have realized and reported separately.

fields.name: fn_profit_loss_a
fields.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

fields.name: fn_profit_loss_q
fields.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

fields.name: fn_repayments_of_debt_a
fields.description: The cash outflow during the period from the repayment of aggregate short-term and long-term debt. Excludes payment of capital lease obligations.

fields.name: fn_repayments_of_debt_q
fields.description: The cash outflow during the period from the repayment of aggregate short-term and long-term debt. Excludes payment of capital lease obligations.

fields.name: fn_repayments_of_lines_of_credit_a
fields.description: Amount of cash outflow for payment of an obligation from a lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.

fields.name: fn_repayments_of_lines_of_credit_q
fields.description: Amount of cash outflow for payment of an obligation from a lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.

fields.name: fn_repayments_of_lt_debt_a
fields.description: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after 1 year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

fields.name: fn_repayments_of_lt_debt_q
fields.description: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after 1 year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

fields.name: fn_repurchased_shares_a
fields.description: Number of shares that have been repurchased during the period.

fields.name: fn_repurchased_shares_q
fields.description: Number of shares that have been repurchased during the period.

fields.name: fn_repurchased_shares_value_a
fields.description: Shares repurchased and either retired or put into treasury stock, likely as part of a share buyback plan.

fields.name: fn_repurchased_shares_value_q
fields.description: Shares repurchased and either retired or put into treasury stock, likely as part of a share buyback plan.

fields.name: fn_taxes_payable_a
fields.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory income, sales, use, payroll, excise, real, property, and other taxes. For classified balance sheets, used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within 1 year or within the normal operating cycle if longer); for unclassified balance sheets, used to reflect the total liabilities (regardless of due date).

fields.name: fn_taxes_payable_q
fields.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory income, sales, use, payroll, excise, real, property and other taxes. For classified balance sheets, used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within 1 year or within the normal operating cycle if longer); for unclassified balance sheets, used to reflect the total liabilities (regardless of due date).

fields.name: fn_treasury_stock_shares_a
fields.description: Number of common and preferred shares that were previously issued and that were repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury on the financial statement date. This stock has no voting rights and receives no dividends.

fields.name: fn_treasury_stock_shares_q
fields.description: Number of common and preferred shares that were previously issued and that were repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury on the financial statement date. This stock has no voting rights and receives no dividends.

fields.name: fn_unrecognized_tax_benefits_a
fields.description: Amount of unrecognized tax benefits.

fields.name: fnd2_a_acmopclcchngcfectnt
fields.description: Accumulated change, net of tax, in accumulated gains and losses from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges. Includes an entity's share of an equity investee's Increase or Decrease in deferred hedging gains or losses.

fields.name: fnd2_a_acmopcldbpoprpnt
fields.description: The total of net gain (loss), prior service cost (credit), and transition assets (obligations), as well as minimum pension liability if still remaining, included in accumulated other comprehensive income associated with a defined benefit pension or other postretirement plan(s) because they have yet to be recognized as components of net periodic benefit cost.

fields.name: fnd2_a_allfdbflaccrwriteoffs
fields.description: Amount of recoveries of receivables doubtful of collection that were previously charged off.

fields.name: fnd2_a_alsbcmpexrsus
fields.description: Allocated Share-Based Compensation Expense, Restricted Stock Units

fields.name: fnd2_a_atdlsecexfcepsastkos
fields.description: Antidilutive Shares Excluded From Earnings Per Share Amount, Stock Options

fields.name: fnd2_a_blgandiprtsg
fields.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of building structures held for productive use including addition, improvement, or renovation to the structure, including, but not limited to, interior masonry, interior flooring, electrical, and plumbing.

fields.name: fnd2_a_bnsacqproformarvn
fields.description: The pro forma revenue for a period as if the business combination or combinations had been completed at the beginning of the period.

fields.name: fnd2_a_bnscbmacqrcsts
fields.description: This element represents acquisition-related costs incurred to effect a business combination which costs have been expensed during the period. Such costs include finder's fees; advisory, legal, accounting, valuation, and other professional or consulting fees; general administrative costs, including the costs of maintaining an internal acquisitions department; and may include costs of registering and issuing debt and equity securities.

fields.name: fnd2_a_consinprogressg
fields.description: Amount of structure or a modification to a structure under construction. Includes recently completed structures or modifications to structures that have not been placed into service.

fields.name: fnd2_a_curritxexp
fields.description: Income Tax Expense, Current

fields.name: fnd2_a_dbplanepdrtnplas
fields.description: An amount calculated as a basis for determining the extent of delayed recognition of the effects of changes in the fair value of assets. The expected return on plan assets is determined based on the expected long-term rate of return on plan assets and the market-related value of plan assets.

fields.name: fnd2_a_dbplanintcst
fields.description: The increase in a defined benefit pension plan's projected benefit obligation or a defined benefit postretirement plan's accumulated postretirement benefit obligation due to the passage of time.

datasets.name: Report Footnotes
datasets.description: This dataset provides granular financial statement footnote data for publicly traded companies, extracted using advanced XBRL technology. It includes detailed disclosures on items such as goodwill, deferred taxes, share-based compensation, and other key financial metrics not typically found in headline financial tables. By enabling users to drill down into historical and cross-company footnote information, the dataset offers unique insights into accounting policies, risk exposures, and non-standard financial events. Such depth of information can help analysts identify hidden risks, spot trends in corporate behavior, and improve the accuracy of fundamental models for predicting price movements.

fields.name: fn_comp_non_opt_vested_q

fields.name: fn_comp_options_exercisable_number_q

fields.name: fn_comp_options_exercisable_weighted_avg_a
fields.description: The weighted-average price as of the balance sheet date at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance on vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable under the stock option plan.

fields.name: fn_comp_options_exercisable_weighted_avg_q

fields.name: fn_comp_options_exercises_weighted_avg_q

fields.name: fn_comp_options_forfeitures_and_expirations_a

fields.name: fn_comp_options_forfeitures_and_expirations_q
fields.description: For presentations that combine terminations, the number of shares under options that were cancelled during the reporting period as a result of occurrence of a terminating event specified in contractual agreements pertaining to the stock option plan or that expired.

fields.name: fn_comp_options_grants_a
fields.description: Net number of share options (or share units) granted during the period.

fields.name: fn_comp_options_grants_fair_value_a
fields.description: Annual Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award Options Grants in Period Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value

fields.name: fn_comp_options_grants_fair_value_q
fields.description: Annual Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award Options Grants in Period Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value

fields.name: fn_comp_options_grants_q

fields.description: Weighted average price at which grantees could have acquired the underlying shares with respect to stock options that were terminated.

fields.name: fn_comp_options_grants_weighted_avg_q
fields.description: Weighted average price at which grantees could have acquired the underlying shares with respect to stock options that were terminated.

fields.name: fn_comp_options_out_intrinsic_value_a
fields.description: The intrinsic value of a stock option is the amount by which the market value of the underlying stock exceeds the exercise price of the option.

fields.name: fn_comp_options_out_intrinsic_value_q
fields.description: The intrinsic value of a stock option is the amount by which the market value of the underlying stock exceeds the exercise price of the option.

fields.name: fn_comp_options_out_number_a
fields.description: Number of options outstanding, including both vested and non-vested options.

fields.name: fn_comp_options_out_number_q
fields.description: Number of options outstanding, including both vested and non-vested options.

fields.name: fn_comp_options_out_weighted_avg_a
fields.description: Weighted average price at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance under the stock option plan.

fields.name: fn_comp_options_out_weighted_avg_q
fields.description: Weighted average price at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance under the stock option plan.

fields.name: fn_comprehensive_income_net_of_tax_a
fields.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income, attributable to parent entity. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

fields.name: fn_comprehensive_income_net_of_tax_q
fields.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income, attributable to parent entity. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

fields.name: fn_debt_instrument_carrying_amount_a

fields.name: fn_debt_instrument_carrying_amount_q

fields.name: fn_debt_instrument_face_amount_q
fields.description: Debt face amount

fields.name: fn_debt_instrument_interest_rate_stated_percentage_q

fields.name: fn_debt_issuance_costs_a

fields.name: fn_debt_issuance_costs_q
fields.description: Amount of debt issuance costs (for example, but not limited to, legal, accounting, broker, and regulatory fees).

fields.name: fn_def_income_tax_expense_q

fields.name: fn_def_tax_assets_liab_net_a
fields.description: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, without jurisdictional netting.

fields.name: fn_def_tax_assets_liab_net_q
fields.description: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, without jurisdictional netting.

fields.name: fn_def_tax_assets_net_a
