fields.name: fn_def_tax_assets_net_q
fields.description: Deferred Tax Assets Net Of Valuation Allowance

fields.name: fn_def_tax_liab_a
fields.description: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences without jurisdictional netting.

fields.name: fn_def_tax_liab_q
fields.description: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences without jurisdictional netting.

fields.name: fn_derivative_fair_value_of_derivative_asset_a
fields.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

fields.name: fn_derivative_fair_value_of_derivative_asset_q
fields.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

fields.name: fn_derivative_fair_value_of_derivative_liability_a
fields.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

fields.name: fn_derivative_fair_value_of_derivative_liability_q
fields.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

fields.name: fn_derivative_notional_amount_a
fields.description: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payments on the derivative liability.

fields.name: fn_derivative_notional_amount_q
fields.description: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payments on the derivative liability.

fields.name: fn_eff_income_tax_rate_continuing_operations_a
fields.description: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

fields.name: fn_eff_income_tax_rate_continuing_operations_q
fields.description: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

fields.name: fn_effect_of_exchange_rate_on_cash_and_equiv_a
fields.description: Amount of increase (decrease) from the effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalent balances held in foreign currencies.

fields.name: fn_effect_of_exchange_rate_on_cash_and_equiv_q
fields.description: Amount of increase (decrease) from the effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalent balances held in foreign currencies.

fields.name: fn_employee_related_liab_a
fields.description: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits. For classified balance sheets, used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within 1 year or within the normal operating cycle if longer); for unclassified balance sheets, used to reflect the total liabilities (regardless of due date).

fields.name: fn_employee_related_liab_q
fields.description: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits. For classified balance sheets, used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within 1 year or within the normal operating cycle if longer); for unclassified balance sheets, used to reflect the total liabilities (regardless of due date).

fields.name: fn_entity_common_stock_shares_out_a
fields.description: Indicate number of shares or other units outstanding of each of registrant's classes of capital or common stock or other ownership interests, if and as stated on cover of related periodic report. Where multiple classes or units exist define each class/interest by adding class of stock items such as Common Class A [Member], Common Class B [Member] or Partnership Interest [Member] onto the Instrument [Domain] of the Entity Listings, Instrument.

fields.name: fn_entity_common_stock_shares_out_q
fields.description: Indicate number of shares or other units outstanding of each of registrant's classes of capital or common stock or other ownership interests, if and as stated on cover of related periodic report. Where multiple classes or units exist define each class/interest by adding class of stock items such as Common Class A [Member], Common Class B [Member] or Partnership Interest [Member] onto the Instrument [Domain] of the Entity Listings, Instrument.

fields.name: fn_excess_tax_benefit_from_share_based_comp_fin_activities_a
fields.description: Amount of cash inflow from realized tax benefit related to deductible compensation cost reported on the entity's tax return for equity instruments in excess of the compensation cost for those instruments recognized for financial reporting purposes.

fields.name: fn_excess_tax_benefit_from_share_based_comp_fin_activities_q
fields.description: Amount of cash inflow from realized tax benefit related to deductible compensation cost reported on the entity's tax return for equity instruments in excess of the compensation cost for those instruments recognized for financial reporting purposes.

fields.name: fn_finite_lived_intangible_assets_acq_a
fields.description: Amount of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life acquired.

fields.name: fn_finite_lived_intangible_assets_acq_q
fields.description: Amount of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life acquired.

fields.name: fn_goodwill_acquired_during_period_q
fields.description: Amount of increase in asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized resulting from a business combination.

fields.name: fn_income_from_equity_investments_q
fields.description: Income From Equity Method Investments

fields.name: fn_income_tax_expense_q
fields.description: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)

fields.description: The amount of cash paid during the current period to foreign, federal, state, and local authorities as taxes on income.

fields.name: fn_income_taxes_paid_q
fields.description: The amount of cash paid during the current period to foreign, federal, state, and local authorities as taxes on income.

fields.name: fn_incremental_shares_attributable_to_share_based_payment_a
fields.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of share-based payment arrangements using the treasury stock method.

fields.name: fn_incremental_shares_attributable_to_share_based_payment_q
fields.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of share-based payment arrangements using the treasury stock method.

fields.name: fn_intangible_assets_accum_amort_a
fields.description: Accumulated amount of amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

fields.name: fn_intangible_assets_accum_amort_q
fields.description: Accumulated amount of amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

fields.name: fn_interest_paid_net_a

fields.name: fn_interest_paid_net_q
fields.description: Net interest

fields.name: fn_interest_payable_a
fields.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of [accrued] interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred and is unpaid. For classified balance sheets, used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within 1 year or within the normal operating cycle if longer); for unclassified balance sheets, used to reflect the total liabilities (regardless of due date).

fields.name: fn_interest_payable_q
fields.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of accrued interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred and is unpaid. For classified balance sheets, used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within 1 year or within the normal operating cycle if longer); for unclassified balance sheets, used to reflect the total liabilities (regardless of due date).

fields.name: fn_line_of_credit_facility_amount_out_a

fields.name: fn_line_of_credit_facility_max_borrowing_capacity_q

fields.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of tangible personal property used to produce goods and services, including, but is not limited to, tools, dies and molds, computer and office equipment.

fields.description: Number of new stock issued during the period.

fields.name: fn_op_lease_min_pay_due_after_5y_a
fields.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due after the 5th fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

fields.name: fn_op_lease_min_pay_due_in_2y_a
fields.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of 1 year due in the 2nd fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

fields.name: fn_op_lease_min_pay_due_in_3y_a
fields.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the 3rd fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

fields.name: fn_op_lease_min_pay_due_in_4y_a
fields.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of 1 year due in the 4th fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

fields.name: fn_op_lease_min_pay_due_in_5y_a
fields.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of 1 year due in the 5th fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

fields.name: fn_op_lease_rent_exp_a
fields.description: Rental expense for the reporting period incurred under operating leases, including minimum and any contingent rent expense, net of related sublease income.

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_available_for_sale_securities_adj_of_tax_a

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_available_for_sale_securities_adj_of_tax_q
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of appreciation (loss) in value of unsold available-for-sale securities. Excludes amounts related to other than temporary impairment (OTTI) loss.

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_derivatives_qualifying_as_hedges_of_tax_a
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_derivatives_qualifying_as_hedges_of_tax_q
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_fx_transaction_and_tax_translation_adj_a
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity, and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_fx_transaction_and_tax_translation_adj_q
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_net_of_tax_a
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

fields.name: fn_oth_income_loss_net_of_tax_q
fields.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

fields.name: fn_payments_for_repurchase_of_common_stock_a
fields.description: Value reported on Cash Flow Statement. May include shares repurchased as part of a buyback plan, as well as shares purchased for employee compensation, etc.

fields.name: fn_payments_for_repurchase_of_common_stock_q
fields.description: Value reported on Cash Flow Statement. May include shares repurchased as part of a buyback plan, as well as shares purchased for employee compensation, etc.

fields.name: fn_payments_to_acquire_businesses_net_of_cash_acquired_a
fields.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

fields.name: fn_payments_to_acquire_businesses_net_of_cash_acquired_q
fields.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

fields.name: fn_ppne_gross_a
fields.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

fields.name: fn_ppne_gross_q
fields.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

fields.name: fn_prepaid_expense_a
fields.description: Carrying amount for an unclassified balance sheet date of expenditures made in advance of when the economic benefit of the cost will be realized, and which will be expensed in future periods with the passage of time or when a triggering event occurs. For a classified balance sheet, represents the noncurrent portion of prepaid expenses (the current portion has a separate concept).

fields.name: fn_prepaid_expense_q
fields.description: Carrying amount for an unclassified balance sheet date of expenditures made in advance of when the economic benefit of the cost will be realized, and which will be expensed in future periods with the passage of time or when a triggering event occurs. For a classified balance sheet, represents the noncurrent portion of prepaid expenses (the current portion has a separate concept).

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_issuance_of_common_stock_a
fields.description: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_issuance_of_common_stock_q
fields.description: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_issuance_of_debt_a
fields.description: The cash inflow during the period from additional borrowings in aggregate debt. Includes proceeds from short-term and long-term debt.

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_issuance_of_debt_q
fields.description: The cash inflow during the period from additional borrowings in aggregate debt. Includes proceeds from short-term and long-term debt.

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_lt_debt_a

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_lt_debt_q
fields.description: Proceeds From Issuance Of Debt, Long Term

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_stock_options_exercised_a
fields.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from holders exercising their stock options. This item inherently excludes any excess tax benefit, which the entity may have realized and reported separately.

fields.name: fn_proceeds_from_stock_options_exercised_q
fields.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from holders exercising their stock options. This item inherently excludes any excess tax benefit, which the entity may have realized and reported separately.

fields.name: fn_profit_loss_a
fields.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

fields.name: fn_profit_loss_q
fields.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

fields.name: fn_repayments_of_debt_a
fields.description: The cash outflow during the period from the repayment of aggregate short-term and long-term debt. Excludes payment of capital lease obligations.

fields.name: fn_repayments_of_debt_q
fields.description: The cash outflow during the period from the repayment of aggregate short-term and long-term debt. Excludes payment of capital lease obligations.

fields.name: fn_repayments_of_lines_of_credit_a
fields.description: Amount of cash outflow for payment of an obligation from a lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.

datasets.name: Company Fundamental Data for Equity
datasets.description: This dataset provides comprehensive, point-in-time global company fundamental data, capturing daily snapshots of financial statements, balance sheets, cash flows, and key ratios as they were known to the market at each historical date. It includes restatements, amendments, and all changes, ensuring accurate backtesting and minimizing look-ahead bias. The dataset covers a wide range of standardized and normalized financial metrics across regions and industries, making it a critical resource for quantitative research, factor modeling, and alpha generation. By reflecting the true information set available to investors at any given time, it enables robust prediction of price movements and supports the development of systematic investment strategies.

datasets.name: Company Fundamental Data for Equity
datasets.description: This dataset provides comprehensive, point-in-time global company fundamental data, capturing daily snapshots of financial statements, balance sheets, cash flows, and key ratios as they were known to the market at each historical date. It includes restatements, amendments, and all changes, ensuring accurate backtesting and minimizing look-ahead bias. The dataset covers a wide range of standardized and normalized financial metrics across regions and industries, making it a critical resource for quantitative research, factor modeling, and alpha generation. By reflecting the true information set available to investors at any given time, it enables robust prediction of price movements and supports the development of systematic investment strategies.

datasets.name: Company Fundamental Data for Equity
datasets.description: This dataset provides comprehensive, point-in-time global company fundamental data, capturing daily snapshots of financial statements, balance sheets, cash flows, and key ratios as they were known to the market at each historical date. It includes restatements, amendments, and all changes, ensuring accurate backtesting and minimizing look-ahead bias. The dataset covers a wide range of standardized and normalized financial metrics across regions and industries, making it a critical resource for quantitative research, factor modeling, and alpha generation. By reflecting the true information set available to investors at any given time, it enables robust prediction of price movements and supports the development of systematic investment strategies.

datasets.name: Company Fundamental Data for Equity
datasets.description: This dataset provides comprehensive, point-in-time global company fundamental data, capturing daily snapshots of financial statements, balance sheets, cash flows, and key ratios as they were known to the market at each historical date. It includes restatements, amendments, and all changes, ensuring accurate backtesting and minimizing look-ahead bias. The dataset covers a wide range of standardized and normalized financial metrics across regions and industries, making it a critical resource for quantitative research, factor modeling, and alpha generation. By reflecting the true information set available to investors at any given time, it enables robust prediction of price movements and supports the development of systematic investment strategies.

datasets.name: Company Fundamental Data for Equity
datasets.description: This dataset provides comprehensive, point-in-time global company fundamental data, capturing daily snapshots of financial statements, balance sheets, cash flows, and key ratios as they were known to the market at each historical date. It includes restatements, amendments, and all changes, ensuring accurate backtesting and minimizing look-ahead bias. The dataset covers a wide range of standardized and normalized financial metrics across regions and industries, making it a critical resource for quantitative research, factor modeling, and alpha generation. By reflecting the true information set available to investors at any given time, it enables robust prediction of price movements and supports the development of systematic investment strategies.

datasets.name: Company Fundamental Data for Equity
datasets.description: This dataset provides comprehensive, point-in-time global company fundamental data, capturing daily snapshots of financial statements, balance sheets, cash flows, and key ratios as they were known to the market at each historical date. It includes restatements, amendments, and all changes, ensuring accurate backtesting and minimizing look-ahead bias. The dataset covers a wide range of standardized and normalized financial metrics across regions and industries, making it a critical resource for quantitative research, factor modeling, and alpha generation. By reflecting the true information set available to investors at any given time, it enables robust prediction of price movements and supports the development of systematic investment strategies.

datasets.name: Company Fundamental Data for Equity
datasets.description: This dataset provides comprehensive, point-in-time global company fundamental data, capturing daily snapshots of financial statements, balance sheets, cash flows, and key ratios as they were known to the market at each historical date. It includes restatements, amendments, and all changes, ensuring accurate backtesting and minimizing look-ahead bias. The dataset covers a wide range of standardized and normalized financial metrics across regions and industries, making it a critical resource for quantitative research, factor modeling, and alpha generation. By reflecting the true information set available to investors at any given time, it enables robust prediction of price movements and supports the development of systematic investment strategies.

datasets.name: Company Fundamental Data for Equity
datasets.description: This dataset provides comprehensive, point-in-time global company fundamental data, capturing daily snapshots of financial statements, balance sheets, cash flows, and key ratios as they were known to the market at each historical date. It includes restatements, amendments, and all changes, ensuring accurate backtesting and minimizing look-ahead bias. The dataset covers a wide range of standardized and normalized financial metrics across regions and industries, making it a critical resource for quantitative research, factor modeling, and alpha generation. By reflecting the true information set available to investors at any given time, it enables robust prediction of price movements and supports the development of systematic investment strategies.

datasets.name: Company Fundamental Data for Equity
datasets.description: This dataset provides comprehensive, point-in-time global company fundamental data, capturing daily snapshots of financial statements, balance sheets, cash flows, and key ratios as they were known to the market at each historical date. It includes restatements, amendments, and all changes, ensuring accurate backtesting and minimizing look-ahead bias. The dataset covers a wide range of standardized and normalized financial metrics across regions and industries, making it a critical resource for quantitative research, factor modeling, and alpha generation. By reflecting the true information set available to investors at any given time, it enables robust prediction of price movements and supports the development of systematic investment strategies.

datasets.name: Company Fundamental Data for Equity
datasets.description: This dataset provides comprehensive, point-in-time global company fundamental data, capturing daily snapshots of financial statements, balance sheets, cash flows, and key ratios as they were known to the market at each historical date. It includes restatements, amendments, and all changes, ensuring accurate backtesting and minimizing look-ahead bias. The dataset covers a wide range of standardized and normalized financial metrics across regions and industries, making it a critical resource for quantitative research, factor modeling, and alpha generation. By reflecting the true information set available to investors at any given time, it enables robust prediction of price movements and supports the development of systematic investment strategies.

datasets.name: Company Fundamental Data for Equity
datasets.description: This dataset provides comprehensive, point-in-time global company fundamental data, capturing daily snapshots of financial statements, balance sheets, cash flows, and key ratios as they were known to the market at each historical date. It includes restatements, amendments, and all changes, ensuring accurate backtesting and minimizing look-ahead bias. The dataset covers a wide range of standardized and normalized financial metrics across regions and industries, making it a critical resource for quantitative research, factor modeling, and alpha generation. By reflecting the true information set available to investors at any given time, it enables robust prediction of price movements and supports the development of systematic investment strategies.

datasets.name: Company Fundamental Data for Equity
datasets.description: This dataset provides comprehensive, point-in-time global company fundamental data, capturing daily snapshots of financial statements, balance sheets, cash flows, and key ratios as they were known to the market at each historical date. It includes restatements, amendments, and all changes, ensuring accurate backtesting and minimizing look-ahead bias. The dataset covers a wide range of standardized and normalized financial metrics across regions and industries, making it a critical resource for quantitative research, factor modeling, and alpha generation. By reflecting the true information set available to investors at any given time, it enables robust prediction of price movements and supports the development of systematic investment strategies.
